title: Solace Materials — onboarding packet & purchase-order routing
text:
Solace Materials — onboarding packet & purchase-order routing

["From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@solacematerials.com>
Cc: procurement@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 09 Aug 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Solace Materials — vendor onboarding packet & PO routing

Hi Aaron,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to start the procurement setup so we can issue POs and get the first shipment scheduled. To get Solace into our vendor master we need a few items from your side. Can you complete the checklist below and upload to the portal (link at the bottom) or reply with the docs attached?

Required items:
- Legal entity name and formation type (LLC / Corp / etc)
- Registered address and remit address (if different)
- Tax ID / EIN (W-9 for US entities)
- Primary AP contact name, email, and PO acceptance email
- ACH details (bank name, account number, routing number) — please send as a separate PDF or secure portal upload
- Copy of business license or articles of incorporation (if available)

Optional but helpful:
- Preferred invoice PDF layout and label for PO number placement
- Any special payment terms (Net 30, Net 45) or early-pay discounts

I've attached our vendor intake form (attachment: vendor_intake_template.pdf) — if you fill that and return it we can speed the entry into our ERP. Once AP confirms the profile we'll provide the first PO number and the invoice routing instructions.

Portal: https://vendors.redwood.ai/portal/upload (secure — please reference Redwood deal ID DEAL-8421)

If easier, reply with the three attachments (W-9, ACH stub, remit confirmation) and I'll move it to AP. Goal: have Solace set up by next Wednesday so we can issue PO before the end of the month.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

- AP contact / invoice routing: ap@solacematerials.com

Please:
1) Verify W-9 and bank details (redact acct number in system view; full details in secure vault)
2) Create vendor master record in the ERP (Oracle NetSuite) using the remit address above
3) Confirm invoice routing and confirm which PO email field we should use for automated PO dispatch (AP said earlier they prefer invoice@vendor vs ap@vendor — please advise)
4) If additional KYC needed (Articles of Incorporation or BOI), flag back to me and I'll request from Solace.

I've attached the three vendor files I received. If AP is okay we should be able to issue the first PO (PO-2028-0842) by Friday.

Thanks — looping in Markus and Kimberly for legal/ops clearance.

Stephanie Nguyen

Thanks, Stephanie — quick notes after a first pass:
- W-9 looks valid; we should store a redacted copy in the vendor record and move the full copy to the secure docs vault.
- Request an Articles of Incorporation PDF (company is US C-corp) — just need to confirm registered agent and incorporation date for audit. Aaron, can you hang on that?
- AP: please set the invoice-to address to ap@solacematerials.com and add invoice@solacematerials.com as a secondary acceptance address in case some invoices come from operations.
- For ACH: good to vault the file; please also confirm micro-deposit verification if our payout team requires it for the first vendor.

Once AP confirms the master record is created, Stephanie — you can proceed with PO issuance.

Markus Klein
Head of Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
